text.content:
Daggerheart SRD rules apply unless TNU says otherwise.

TNU domain cards use Skill, Tech, Psionic, Engram, and Sigil card types. In v2.0_Mind, the playable cards are Skill, Tech, and Sigil.

Charges are stored on Tech cards and charge-storing class features. After a long rest, unused Charge tokens are lost.

Sigil cards begin on their Seal side. After successful use, mark a Hit Point to flip to Release; after Release is used, flip back to Seal.

daggerheartSpace.source: The New Unknown Playtest Volume 2.0 - Mind
